intro: Applying for jobs shouldn't take hours. This is Hiresprint.
setup: Hiresprint reads it and fills in your profile for you, so setup takes about a minute.
match: Open any job posting, and Hiresprint instantly shows how well your resume matches.
Click it to see the skills you have, and the ones you're missing.
tailor: Want a better match? Tailor your resume in one click.
Hiresprint rewrites your own bullet points in the job's words, without inventing anything, and your match score goes up.
It keeps your resume's design, and attaches the tailored version to this application.
autofill: Now open the application, and click Autofill.
In seconds, the whole form is filled. Green answers come from your profile, and blue ones are AI suggestions for you to review.
It even writes a cover letter for this exact job.
Check the list, and submit it yourself. Twenty minutes of typing, done in about one.
ats: Run an ATS check to see how hiring systems read your resume, and exactly what to fix.
studio: Save answers like your salary and notice period once, and they're filled the same way on every application.
outro: Hiresprint works on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, LinkedIn, and more. Add it to Chrome for free, and apply in minutes, not hours.
